parameters.name: Portable transmit power, VHF
parameters.why: 6 W max on APX 8000 (VHF 1-6 W) and XL Converge 200P (VHF 1-6 W) = 37.8 dBm. MOTOTRBO R7 (DMR) is 5 W = 37.0 dBm. Conducted rated power, before antenna/body loss.

parameters.name: Portable transmit power, UHF
parameters.why: 5 W max on APX 8000 (UHF R1 and R2 1-5 W) and XL Converge 200P (1-5 W) = 37.0 dBm. MOTOTRBO R7 UHF is 4 W = 36.0 dBm.

parameters.name: Portable transmit power, 700 MHz
parameters.why: APX 8000 is 1-2.5 W at 700 MHz (34.0 dBm); XL Converge 200P is 0.5-3 W on 700/800 (34.8 dBm). Default uses the lower, more conservative maximum.

parameters.name: Portable transmit power, 800 MHz
parameters.why: APX 8000 800 MHz 1-3 W and XL Converge 200P 3 W = 34.8 dBm; MOTOTRBO R7 800/900 is 2.5 W = 34.0 dBm.

parameters.name: AHJ design portable transmit level
parameters.why: OCSD requires designs to assume a 34 dBm portable; Radio Solutions' example uses a 3 W/34 dBm ERP portable; Comba's example uses about +35 dBm radiated. Use when the AHJ fixes the portable level instead of the radio's rated power.

parameters.name: Portable antenna correction (incl. body absorption, head level), VHF
parameters.applies_to: uplink and downlink at the portable; 136-174 MHz
parameters.why: TSB-88.1-C draft Table D-3: -10 dBd for 136-174 MHz, relative to a half-wave dipole, including antenna efficiency, polarization and body absorption at head level. Hill & Kneisel measured -11.3 dBd median for a VHF helical at head height (via Urgent Communications). Hip-worn radios lose more (TSB-88 Table D-5, not public).

parameters.name: Portable antenna correction (incl. body absorption, head level), UHF
parameters.why: TSB-88.1-C draft Table D-3: -6 dBd for 406-512 MHz, head level.

parameters.name: Portable antenna correction (incl. body absorption, head level), 700/800 MHz
parameters.why: TSB-88.1-C draft Table D-3: -5 dBd for the 700, 800 and 900 MHz bands, head level. Hill & Kneisel measured -4.5 dBd median for an 800 MHz coaxial dipole at head height.

parameters.name: Separate body loss (only when the portable antenna is entered as a free-space gain)
parameters.applies_to: uplink and downlink at the portable
parameters.why: Suneast's UHF rule-of-thumb budget uses 3 dB body loss (low-authority integrator blog). Set to 0 when the TSB-88 portable antenna correction is used, because that correction already includes body absorption. No public source gives hip-worn loss values; TSB-88 Table D-5 (median portable antenna loss) is paywalled.

parameters.name: Minimum downlink signal at the portable
parameters.why: -95 dBm: IFC 2021 510.4.1.1 (plus DAQ 3.0), IFC 2015 and NFPA 72-2013 24.5.2.3.1, San Diego C-1, Durham grid test, OCSD grid test. IFC 2024 and NFPA 1225-2022 specify DAQ only, no dBm. Durham accepts -100 dBm (with BER <= 2.0% and SINR >= 17.7 dB) in the initial pre-construction survey.

parameters.name: Minimum uplink signal at the donor site receiver
parameters.why: NFPA 72-2013 24.5.2.3.2: -95 dBm outbound at the donor site; OCSD: per-channel uplink at the donor site not less than -95 dBm; Durham: greater than -95 dBm received at the tower; Santa Clara County C-2: -95 dBm at the designated donor site receiver antenna.

parameters.name: Maximum uplink signal at the donor site receiver
parameters.why: OCSD: not greater than -75 dBm per channel at the donor site; Durham: less than -80 dBm at the tower.

parameters.name: Maximum downlink level at or near the building interior perimeter
parameters.why: OCSD 9(a)(i): avoid downlink levels exceeding -75 dBm at or near the building interior perimeter.

parameters.name: Maximum signal leakage 50 ft outside the building
parameters.why: Durham: leakage map and CW test must show no more than -89 dBm at 50 ft from the building edge.

parameters.name: Maximum signal leakage 100 ft outside the building
parameters.why: Durham: no more than -95 dBm at 100 ft from the building edge.

parameters.name: Booster signal margin below the outdoor (macro) signal at the building edge
parameters.why: OCSD: leakage at ground level 3-25 ft outside must be at least 15 dB below the measured donor signal; Santa Clara County C-2: booster signal immediately inside exterior walls at least 15 dB below the exterior macro signal.

parameters.name: Design DAQ target
parameters.why: NFPA 1225 A.18.9.1 recommends designing for DAQ 3.4 as a safety factor; San Diego C-1, Santa Clara C-2 (digital) and OCSD acceptance require DAQ 3.4.

parameters.name: Minimum SINR for DAQ (P25 C4FM)
parameters.applies_to: downlink measurement with a P25 decoder
parameters.why: TSB-88.1-C draft Table A-1, C4FM narrow IF: 16.5 dB for DAQ 3.0, 17.7 dB for DAQ 3.4. Durham requires 17.7 dB; NFPA 1225 A.20.3.10 cites 18 dB; San Diego C-1 requires 20 dB.

parameters.name: Maximum BER for DAQ (P25 C4FM)
parameters.applies_to: downlink measurement with a P25 decoder
parameters.why: TSB-88.1-C draft Table A-1, C4FM: 2.6% BER for DAQ 3.0, 2.0% for DAQ 3.4. Durham and San Diego require <= 2.0%; NFPA 1225 A.20.3.10 cites 2.5%.

parameters.name: Required coverage, general areas
parameters.why: IFC 2024 510.4.1 and NFPA 1225 18.8.4: 95%. NFPA 72-2013 and NFPA 1221 (2016/2019) used 90%; Santa Clara C-2 still uses 90%.

parameters.name: Required coverage, critical areas
parameters.applies_to: critical areas (fire command center, pump room, exit stairs, elevator lobbies, standpipes...)

parameters.name: Donor-to-server isolation margin above system gain
parameters.why: NFPA 1225-2022 18.3.3.2 and 18.10, IFC 2018/2021/2024 510.4.2.4 item 4, Fiplex HONBDA-7S datasheet (Max Gain + 20 dB), OCSD (20 dB above the amplifier's maximum rated gain, >100 dB desired), San Diego C-1, Durham (max gain = isolation - 20 dB). NFPA 72-2013 24.5.2.3.3 required 15 dB, and NPSTC's 2007 rule of thumb is gain + 15 dB.

parameters.name: Maximum uplink gain allowed by AHJ
parameters.why: OCSD (without prior approval), San Diego C-1 (unless approved) and Durham all cap uplink gain at 65 dB. 47 CFR 90.219 has no gain limit.

parameters.name: Maximum uplink power at the BDA donor port
parameters.why: OCSD 9(c): uplink not to exceed 27 dBm at the amplifier donor port.

parameters.name: Maximum ERP per retransmitted channel
parameters.why: 47 CFR 90.219(d)(3)(i): 5 W ERP per retransmitted channel on forward and reverse links = 37.0 dBm ERP. OCSD also caps uplink at 37 dBm ERP.

parameters.name: Maximum spread of uplink input levels at the BDA (near vs far portable)
parameters.why: OCSD 9(a)(ii): uplink power presented to the amplifier should vary by no more than 20 dB from minimum to maximum and stay inside the AGC range. NFPA 1225 18.3.4.1 and IFC 510.4.2.8 require minimizing near-far effects but give no number.

parameters.name: BDA noise figure
parameters.why: 47 CFR 90.219(e)(2) caps booster noise figure at 9 dB in either direction; use 9 dB when the datasheet is not at hand. Datasheets: Fiplex HONBDA-7S 9.0 dB max, Fiplex FLEX 2.0 <9 dB, ADRF PSR-78-9537-U 5 dB at max gain, Nextivity SHIELD SOLO 5 dB, Comba V3/NG UL <5 dB at 90 dB gain and <9 dB at 67 dB gain, NOTIFIER 6.5 dB typ / 8 dB max.

parameters.name: BDA maximum composite downlink output (per band)
parameters.why: Product-specific, so no default: Fiplex HONBDA-7S +27 or +33 dBm; Comba V3/NG 27/33 dBm; Nextivity SHIELD SOLO 27 dBm; NOTIFIER 28-32 dBm; ADRF PSR-78-9537-U 37 dBm; Fiplex FLEX 2.0 remote VHF 30 / UHF 37 dBm.

parameters.name: BDA maximum composite uplink output (per band)
parameters.why: Product-specific: Fiplex 24 dBm, Nextivity 26 dBm, Comba 27 dBm (master unit), ADRF 30 dBm.

parameters.name: BDA maximum gain
parameters.applies_to: isolation check (some AHJs use maximum rated gain)
parameters.why: Product-specific: Fiplex 85 dB, Comba 90 dB, Nextivity 90 dB, NOTIFIER 92 dB max, ADRF 95 dB.

parameters.name: BDA maximum input without overdrive
parameters.why: Product-specific: ADRF -20 dBm (no overdrive), NOTIFIER -20 dBm (for FCC spurious compliance), Comba -10 dBm (no overdrive), Fiplex -5 dBm (normal operation). Comba's guidance: set the donor level so the BDA is not in AGC under normal conditions.

parameters.name: Extra output backoff below composite - 10log(N)
parameters.why: No opened source gives a backoff value. NPSTC and Durham use composite - 10log10(N) only; vendors specify IMD/spurious at < -13 dBm at rated power. Leave 0 unless the manufacturer specifies one.

parameters.name: Loss per connector, feed-through or adapter
parameters.why: Campbell Scientific: an acceptable approximation is 0.1 dB per connector, feed-thru or adapter. Count each mated interface once.

parameters.name: Jumper loss, 1/2 in superflexible, DC-1 GHz
parameters.applies_to: jumpers at BDA, donor and antennas
parameters.why: Rosenberger 4.3-10 jumper assemblies, DC-1 GHz: <= 0.10 dB/m + 0.01 dB (1/2 in superflexible), <= 0.07 dB/m + 0.01 dB (1/2 in flexible). Add 0.01 dB per jumper.

parameters.name: Surge (lightning) protector insertion loss
parameters.why: PolyPhaser IS-50NX-C2-ME (125 MHz-1 GHz): 0.1 dB. Campbell's example budget uses 0.5 dB for a surge kit.

parameters.name: Coax attenuation
parameters.why: Cable- and frequency-specific, so no default. Example CommScope LDF4-50A (1/2 in): 0.815 @150 MHz, 0.88 @174, 1.447 @450, 1.831 @700, 1.968 @800, 2.089 @894 MHz (dB/100 ft, 20 C).

parameters.name: 2-way splitter loss (split + dissipative)
parameters.why: Microlab D2-61 (70-2700 MHz, covers VHF): 3 dB split + <0.6 dB dissipative at 150-1000 MHz (<0.5 at 120-150) = 3.6 dB. RFS PDS2 (350-2700): 3.3 dB. Microlab D2-08 (380-2700): 3 dB + <0.1 dB. Default is the only VHF-capable sheet.

parameters.name: 3-way splitter loss
parameters.why: RFS PDS3 (350-2700): 5.2 dB; Microlab D3-08 (380-2700): 4.8 dB + <0.1 dB. No VHF 3-way sheet opened.

parameters.name: 4-way splitter loss
parameters.why: RFS PDS4 (350-2700): 6.5 dB; Microlab D4-08 (380-2700): 6 dB + <0.1 dB. No VHF 4-way sheet opened.

parameters.name: 10 dB coupler through loss
parameters.why: DDC240-10 (138-960 MHz): 1.2 dB; Microlab CK-771: 1.1 dB.

parameters.name: 15 dB coupler through loss
parameters.why: DDC240-15: 0.5 dB; Microlab CK-751: 0.5 dB.

parameters.name: 6 dB coupler tap loss
parameters.why: Nominal coupling value; DDC240-06 tolerance +/-1.5 dB (CK-761 +/-1.0 dB above 380 MHz).

parameters.name: 10 dB coupler tap loss
parameters.why: Nominal coupling value; DDC240-10 tolerance +/-1.7 dB.

parameters.name: 15 dB coupler tap loss
parameters.why: Nominal coupling value; DDC240-15 tolerance +/-1.7 dB.

parameters.name: 20 dB coupler tap loss
parameters.why: Nominal coupling value; DDC240-20 tolerance +/-1.7 dB.

parameters.name: 2x2 hybrid combiner loss per path
parameters.why: Microlab CA-PS-2x2-196FN (128-1000 MHz): 3.1 +/- 1.2 dB all paths, 23 dB min input isolation; unused port must be terminated.

parameters.name: Mismatch loss at VSWR 2:1
parameters.why: Campbell Scientific: VSWR 2:1 equals 0.511 dB mismatch loss.

parameters.name: Indoor omni gain, VHF
parameters.why: Sinclair SI240F-O: -3 to -1 dBi typical at 132-174 MHz; default is the low end.

parameters.name: Indoor omni gain, UHF
parameters.why: Sinclair SI240F-O: 0 to 2 dBi typical at 350-520 MHz; default is the low end.

parameters.name: Indoor omni gain, 700/800 MHz
parameters.why: Sinclair SI240F-O: 1 to 4 dBi typical at 698-960 MHz; default is the low end.

parameters.name: Donor antenna gain
parameters.why: Design input, no default. OCSD requires >= 13 dBd (15 dBi) and 30 dB front-to-back at 800 MHz; Sinclair SY307R UHF Yagi 10 dBd (12.1 dBi), F/B 15 dB; NPSTC calls a 10 dB directional typical at 800 MHz.

parameters.name: Agency site ERP per channel
parameters.why: Get it from the AHJ technical document (IFC 510.4.2.2 requires the fire code official to publish site ERPs). Published examples: San Diego 800/700 P25 sites 42.14-50 dBm ERP; Comba VHF example +53 dBm per channel; Radio Solutions example 47 dBm (50 W).

parameters.name: Site receiver static sensitivity, P25 C4FM 5% BER (700/800/UHF)
parameters.why: Motorola GTR 8000 (G-Series data sheet): C4FM 5% BER -118 dBm at 700/800 and UHF, -119 dBm at VHF; H-CPM (Phase 2) -116 dBm (700/800, UHF) and -117 dBm (VHF). Pericle cites -118 dBm as a typical P25 Phase I static sensitivity.

parameters.name: Site receiver static sensitivity, P25 C4FM 5% BER, VHF
parameters.why: GTR 8000 VHF C4FM 5% BER.

parameters.name: Site receiver static sensitivity, P25 Phase 2 H-CPM 5% BER
Site receiver analog sensitivity 12 dB SINAD, 12.5 kHz
Faded threshold for DAQ 3.4, P25
parameters.applies_to: downlink at portable and uplink at site
parameters.why: Pericle drive-test guide: common DAQ 3.4 fading-channel thresholds are -106 dBm for P25 and -101 dBm for analog NPSPAC radios (from TSB-88); Pericle ATP slides: -105 dBm. Computing from TSB-88.1-C draft (GTR 8000 -118 dBm, Cs/N 7.6 dB, Cf/(I+N) 17.7 dB) gives -107.9 dBm.

parameters.name: Static Cs/N at reference sensitivity, C4FM 12.5 kHz (narrow IF)
parameters.why: TSB-88.1-C draft Table A-1: 5% BER at 7.6 dB (narrow IF); 5.4 dB with wide IF.

parameters.name: Faded Cf/(I+N) for DAQ 3.0, C4FM
parameters.why: TSB-88.1-C draft Table A-1: 2.6% BER / 16.5 dB (narrow IF), 15.2 dB (wide IF).

parameters.name: Faded Cf/(I+N) for DAQ 3.4, C4FM
parameters.why: TSB-88.1-C draft Table A-1: 2.0% BER / 17.7 dB (narrow IF), 16.2 dB (wide IF).

parameters.name: Static Cs/N at 12 dB SINAD, analog FM +/-2.5 kHz
parameters.why: TSB-88.1-C draft Table A-1.

parameters.name: Faded C/(I+N) for DAQ 3.0, analog FM 12.5 kHz
parameters.why: TSB-88.1-C draft Table A-1 (17 dB for 25 kHz +/-5 kHz; 19 dB for NPSPAC +/-4 kHz).

parameters.name: Faded C/(I+N) for DAQ 3.4, analog FM 12.5 kHz
parameters.why: TSB-88.1-C draft Table A-1 and NTIA 07-447 (26 dB); 20 dB for 25 kHz, 22 dB for NPSPAC.

parameters.name: Environmental noise degradation at the site
parameters.why: TSB-88.1-C draft D.3.12: assume 6 dB derating for 132-174 MHz, 3 dB for 406-512 MHz and 3 dB at 700 MHz (CMRS noise). Band-specific, so no single default.

parameters.name: Thermal noise density at 290 K
parameters.why: Keysight (App Note 57-1 summary): -174 dBm/Hz at 290 K.

parameters.name: Channel bandwidth for noise calculations
parameters.why: P25/DMR/analog narrowband channels are 12.5 kHz; P25 Phase 2 TDMA is 6.25 kHz equivalent; 25 kHz legacy wideband. 47 CFR 90.219(d)(6) noise limits and NFPA 1225 A.18.9.3 measurements use a 10 kHz bandwidth.

parameters.name: Noise measurement bandwidth
parameters.applies_to: uplink noise ERP and site noise checks
parameters.why: 47 CFR 90.219(d)(6)(i)-(iii) state limits in a 10 kHz measurement bandwidth; NFPA 1225 A.18.9.3 says use 10 kHz for 12.5 kHz and 800 MHz 25 kHz systems; OCSD measures transmitted noise in 10 kHz.

parameters.name: Maximum uplink noise ERP within the passband
parameters.why: 47 CFR 90.219(d)(6)(ii); San Diego C-1 and OCSD repeat it.

parameters.name: Maximum noise ERP more than 1 MHz outside the passband
Maximum BDA noise received at the donor site
parameters.why: OCSD (calculated noise at donor site not greater than -150 dBm), San Diego C-1 (-150 dBm), Santa Clara C-2 (-150 dBm in-band); Durham uses -153 dBm. None of these states the bandwidth; compute in 10 kHz.

parameters.name: Maximum noise-floor rise at the closest site
parameters.why: NFPA 1225 18.9.3 forbids raising the site noise floor; A.18.9.3 says a rise of 1 dB or more requires attenuation or gain reduction.

parameters.name: Extra uplink attenuation after noise returns to idle
parameters.why: NFPA 1225 A.18.9.3: add 3 dB more attenuation or gain reduction as a safety factor.

parameters.name: Design (fade) margin over the required level
parameters.applies_to: downlink edge and uplink at site
parameters.why: No code sets a dB margin. Suneast (integrator blog, low authority) uses 15 dB for life-safety and 10 dB for commercial designs over -95 dBm; NPSTC notes designers commonly target -85 dBm (10 dB over -95). Prefer the statistical margin z*sigma when sigma is known.

parameters.name: Indoor shadow-fading standard deviation
parameters.why: P.1238-13 Table 2 site-general sigma: office NLoS 5.01 dB (range 2.62-7.58 across environments). P.1238-10 Table 4: 3.4 dB at 0.8 GHz open office (LoS), 10 dB office/commercial at 1.8-2 GHz.

parameters.name: One-sided normal z for 95% confidence
parameters.why: Pericle Table A.2: z = 1.28 (90%), 1.65 (95%), 2.32 (99%) for a 'greater than' test.

parameters.name: COST 231 multi-wall: light wall loss (1800 MHz)
parameters.why: COST 231 Tab. 4.7.2 at 1800 MHz. At 900 MHz the light-wall loss was 1.5 dB lower; Ericsson measured 2.1 dB for plasterboard at 900 MHz.

parameters.name: COST 231 multi-wall: heavy wall loss (1800 MHz)
parameters.why: COST 231 Tab. 4.7.2; no 900 MHz adjustment given for heavy walls.

parameters.name: COST 231 multi-wall: floor loss (1800 MHz)
parameters.why: COST 231 Tab. 4.7.2; floor loss was 3.5 dB lower at 900 MHz.

parameters.name: COST 231 multi-wall floor exponent b
parameters.why: COST 231 Tab. 4.7.2.

parameters.name: Indoor antenna spacing rule of thumb
parameters.why: No universal default. Comba (simplex/split DAS): downlink antennas about 100-150 ft apart, first one within about 50 ft of the perimeter. Suneast (UHF, blog): 20-35 m (66-115 ft) apart in open floors, 15-20 m (49-66 ft) in partitioned floors; one antenna per 1,000-1,500 m2 open or 400-700 m2 partitioned.

formulas.name: Power conversion
formulas.explain: Use for datasheet watts (5 W = 37.0 dBm, 3 W = 34.8 dBm, 2.5 W = 34.0 dBm).

formulas.name: ERP to EIRP
formulas.explain: A half-wave dipole is 2.15 dBi (TSB-88.1-C draft Table D-2). FCC 90.219 and most AHJs state ERP; antenna gains in dBd go with ERP.

formulas.name: Radiated power
formulas.explain: Transmitter power minus feeder losses plus antenna gain.

formulas.name: Free-space basic transmission loss
formulas.explain: ITU-R P.525-5 eq. (6). Minimum possible loss; real donor paths add diffraction and clutter (Durham requires FSPL estimates plus an elevation profile).

formulas.name: ITU-R P.1238 distance-coefficient model
formulas.explain: P.1238-10 eq. (1), P.1238-13 eq. (2). d > 1 m, reference L(1 m) = 20log f - 28. N already includes walls on one floor; Lf(n) = 0 on the same floor. Use the p1238 table for N and Lf. From P.1238-11 (09/2021) on, the N table no longer lists 0.8-2.2 GHz values, so sub-GHz N comes from P.1238-10.

formulas.name: ITU-R P.1238-13 site-general model
formulas.explain: P.1238-13 eq. (1), same-floor only, f >= 0.3 GHz (0.45 or 0.625 GHz for some rows). Not valid at VHF.

formulas.name: COST 231 multi-wall model
formulas.formula: L = L_FS + L_c + sum_i(k_wi*L_wi) + k_f^((k_f+2)/(k_f+1) - b) * L_f
formulas.explain: Free-space loss plus loss per penetrated wall type and a non-linear floor term. L_c is a regression constant, normally close to zero. Coefficients in parameters cost231_*.

formulas.name: Location margin from shadow fading
formulas.explain: z from the confidence level (1.65 for 95%), sigma from P.1238. Office NLoS at 95%: 1.65*5.01 = 8.3 dB.

formulas.name: Composite power of several carriers
formulas.explain: Total power through a broadband amplifier is the sum of all carriers in its passband (NPSTC Appendix E).

formulas.name: Per-channel output at full composite
formulas.explain: NPSTC: 27 dBm/ch for 2 channels = 24 dBm/ch for 4 = 21 for 8; 1 W composite with 40 channels = +14 dBm/ch. Durham: max output = BDA output - 10log(24).

formulas.name: Downlink chain to the far edge
formulas.formula: P_in = ERP_site + 2.15 - PL_out + G_donor_dBi - L_donor; P_out_ch = min(P_in + G_dl, P_ch); P_ant = P_out_ch - L_passive; P_edge = P_ant + G_srv_dBi - L_in(d) + G_port_dBi - L_body
formulas.explain: Site EIRP, outdoor path, donor gain, donor line, BDA gain capped by per-channel power, passive network, server antenna, indoor path, portable antenna/body. Comba's worked example follows this order.

formulas.name: Uplink chain to the site receiver
formulas.formula: EIRP_port = P_port + G_port_dBi - L_body; P_bda_in = EIRP_port - L_in(d) + G_srv_dBi - L_passive; P_bda_out = min(P_bda_in + G_ul, P_ul_max); ERP_donor = P_bda_out - L_donor - L_atten + G_donor_dBd; P_site = ERP_donor + 2.15 - PL_out + G_site_dBi - L_site_feed
formulas.explain: Comba's example stops at the tower (-95 dBm 'received at tower'), the convention used by OCSD, Durham and Santa Clara for the -95 dBm uplink rule.

formulas.name: Passive network loss to one antenna
formulas.formula: L_passive = sum(cable_dB_per_100ft * len_ft/100) + n_conn*0.1 + sum(jumper 0.10*L_m + 0.01) + splitters + coupler_through(s) + coupler_tap (if on the tap leg) + hybrid + surge
formulas.explain: Walk the path from BDA port to the antenna; a coupler costs its through loss on the main line and its coupling value on the tap.

formulas.name: Mismatch loss
formulas.explain: VSWR 2:1 gives 0.511 dB (Campbell eq. 3-1).

formulas.name: Thermal noise floor
formulas.explain: 12.5 kHz: -133.0 dBm + NF; 10 kHz: -134.0 dBm + NF; 6.25 kHz: -136.0 dBm + NF. Urgent Communications uses kTB = -133 dBm for 12.6 kHz.

formulas.name: BDA uplink output noise
formulas.explain: Input-referred thermal noise amplified by the uplink gain (Comba estimates channel noise at the BDA output from kTB and NF).

formulas.name: Uplink noise ERP from the donor antenna
formulas.formula: N_ERP = N_out(10 kHz) - L_donor - L_atten + G_donor_dBd
formulas.explain: Compare with -43 dBm in 10 kHz (90.219(d)(6)(ii)). Example: NF 5, G 65 dB: -134+5+65 = -64 dBm; -2 dB line, +8 dBd = -58 dBm ERP.

formulas.name: BDA noise delivered to the site
formulas.explain: Same path as the uplink signal. Compare with -150 dBm (OCSD, San Diego, Santa Clara) or -153 dBm (Durham).

formulas.name: Site receiver noise floor from its sensitivity
formulas.explain: TSB-88 relation (NTIA 07-447): reference sensitivity sits Cs/N above the noise. GTR 8000 C4FM: -118 - 7.6 = -125.6 dBm. Add environmental derating where TSB-88 says (VHF 6 dB, UHF/700 3 dB).

formulas.name: Noise-floor rise at the site
formulas.explain: Power sum of BDA noise and site noise. NFPA 1225 A.18.9.3 acts at 1 dB, reached when BDA noise is about 5.9 dB below the floor.

formulas.name: Faded performance threshold for a DAQ
Isolation requirement
formulas.explain: NFPA 1225 18.3.3.2/18.10 and IFC 510.4.2.4(4): 20 dB above system gain. OCSD uses the amplifier's maximum rated gain. Durham: maximum gain = isolation - 20 dB. NPSTC/NFPA 72-2013 used +15 dB.

formulas.name: Isolation measurement
formulas.explain: Durham commissioning: inject a tone into a server antenna and measure it at the donor; compute isolation per band and set gain from it.

formulas.name: Overall isolation for a 4-port (simplex) BDA
formulas.explain: Comba: overall isolation must exceed combined DL and UL gain by a design margin M; per-path targets: donor DL-UL port > 65 dB, DAS DL-UL > 90 dB, donor DL-DAS DL = DL gain + 20 dB, donor UL-DAS UL = UL gain + 20 dB.

formulas.name: Uplink at site from an inbound reading
formulas.explain: Radio Solutions: with a reciprocal path, the outbound level equals the inbound reading minus the ERP difference. Example: -85 dBm inbound, 47 - 34 = 13 dB, so -98 dBm outbound (fails -95).

checks.name: Downlink level at the far edge
checks.rule: Compute P_edge per channel at the worst location of each area.

checks.name: Downlink DAQ threshold
checks.rule: Faded threshold at the portable: S_static - Cs/N + Cf/N(DAQ).
checks.pass_if: P_edge >= faded threshold for daq_design (+ shadow margin z*sigma)

checks.name: Uplink level at the site receiver
checks.rule: Compute P_site per channel from the farthest portable.

checks.name: Uplink DAQ at the site
checks.rule: Faded threshold at the site receiver from its sensitivity.
checks.pass_if: P_site >= S_site - Cs/N + Cf/N(DAQ 3.4) + margin (GTR 8000 C4FM: -107.9 dBm + margin)

checks.name: Donor-to-server isolation
checks.rule: Isolation (calculated or measured) against the highest gain setting; some AHJs use the amplifier's maximum rated gain.
checks.pass_if: isolation_db >= max(G_dl, G_ul) + 20 (warn below +20, fail below +15)

checks.name: Uplink noise ERP
checks.rule: N_ERP in 10 kHz from bda_output_noise and uplink_noise_erp.
checks.pass_if: N_ERP <= -43 dBm/10 kHz in band; <= -70 dBm/10 kHz beyond 1 MHz

checks.name: BDA noise at the donor site
checks.pass_if: N_site <= -150 dBm (OCSD/San Diego/Santa Clara) or <= -153 dBm (Durham), per the AHJ

checks.name: Noise-floor rise
checks.rule: noise_rise against the site floor from site_noise_floor_from_sens.
checks.pass_if: dN < 1 dB; then plan 3 dB extra attenuation

checks.name: BDA downlink headroom
checks.rule: Per-channel output with all N channels active.

checks.name: BDA input range
checks.rule: Donor input per band and uplink input from the nearest portable.
checks.pass_if: P_in <= bda_max_input_dbm (datasheet) and BDA not in AGC under normal donor conditions

checks.name: Uplink gain cap
checks.pass_if: G_ul <= 65 dB unless the AHJ approves more

checks.name: Uplink power limits
checks.rule: Per-channel uplink at donor port and ERP from the donor antenna.
checks.pass_if: P_donor_port <= 27 dBm (OCSD) and ERP_donor <= 37 dBm (5 W, 90.219(d)(3)(i))

checks.name: Uplink input spread
checks.rule: Difference between nearest and farthest portable at the BDA uplink input.
checks.pass_if: spread <= 20 dB and within the BDA AGC range

checks.name: Signal leakage outside the building
checks.pass_if: <= -89 dBm @50 ft and <= -95 dBm @100 ft (Durham); >= 15 dB below the donor signal at the perimeter (OCSD, Santa Clara); <= -75 dBm at the interior perimeter (OCSD)

checks.name: Booster class vs AHJ
checks.pass_if: Class A if every passband <= 75 kHz; meet AHJ class rules (Durham: Class A only)

checks.name: Coverage percentage per floor
checks.rule: Share of grids or floor area passing dl_edge and ul_site checks.
checks.pass_if: >= 95% general and >= 99% critical areas (IFC 2024 / NFPA 1225); some AHJs 90%
